scientific_integrity: The proof gives exact analytic rational differences and sign analyses across the complete parameter domain. Exact symbolic identities and independent finite rational inversions are separately reproducible; finite tests are not presented as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exactly four leaders, identical strictly positive finite feedback gains, unit-conductance friendship graphs, and inverse-trace stochastic coherence. It does not treat unequal gains, other clique bouquets, or optimally varied feedback strengths. Full text of a directly relevant 2020 windmill-coherence paper was not inspected; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Four-leader phase transitions on friendship networks
